title: Juicy Velvety Saudi Arabian Beef Skillet
description: A fresh and cozy Saudi Arabian dish featuring beef gravy, cooked to perfection in a cast-iron skillet, this recipe is shojin-friendly and sure to please.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste, beef broth, salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Use a bain-marie to keep the skillet at a constant temperature, if necessary.
Serve the beef and gravy hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
